name: bottom-sheet-detents
title: Bottom Sheet Detents
description: A bottom sheet with a collapsed/expanded detent pair cycled through the drag handle. The standard variant coexists with the underlying screen (no scrim, background stays interactive); the modal variant adds a scrim that blocks interaction until dismissed. Both offer a non-drag way to change detent — tapping the handle — because not every input is a drag gesture.
